ja363:1.2: (cfr. Suttanipāta v.253 p.204-205) tavāham asmī iti bhāsamānaṃ
ja363:1.4: n' eso mamanti iti taṃ vijaññā.
ja363:2.1: Yaṃ hi kayirā taṃ hi vade
ja363:2.2: yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade,
ja363:3.1: Na so mitto yo sadā appamatto (=
ja363:3.2: supra p.192 v.5.) bhedāsaṃkī randham evānupassī,
ja363:3.4: sa ve mitto yo abhejjo parehi.
